$comment: The confirmed launch photographs the public site renders — content/launch/README.md is the record of where each one came from. `file` is the tracked source under content/launch/photos/; `slot` names the derivative folder under public/media/; `width` and `height` are the measured source dimensions, re-measured and enforced by scripts/images/build-static-derivatives.mjs; `alt` is the description a screen reader hears (null renders alt="", the accepted model for a photograph beside the text that names it). dish-tapas.png is not listed: the public Tapas board is a text table by design and renders no photograph.
